title: Elif's first month
subtitle: Four weeks in Boston — questions with did
canDo: I can ask questions in the past: Did you …? Where did you go?
I can give short answers: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
I can write about my last month.
teacherNotes: A1'in son dersi! Yazma görevini (My last month) ödev verin; geri bildirimde Ünite 7–8'in zamanlarını (present continuous, past simple) kontrol edin.
did ile soru: Türkçedeki -mi ekine benzetin. did soruyu yapar, fiil yalın kalır: Did you buy …? (bought değil).
Soru zinciri: öğrenciler birbirine "Did you … yesterday / last weekend?" diye sorsun; cevap "Yes, I did / No, I didn't" + bir cümle.
Okuma metni A1 hikâyesinin özeti. Öğrencilerle Ünite 1'den bu yana neler olduğunu hatırlayın: Elif'in dairesi, işi, montu, konser, maklube.

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: My first month in Boston
sections.intro: Elif's article for the school newsletter.
paragraphs: I came to Boston on the first of September. It was hot and sunny, and I didn't have any friends here.
On my first day at Harbor English School, I met Maya, our teacher, and my classmates Omar and Lucas.
I was very quiet, but they were very friendly.
In my first week, I found a small apartment on Harbor Street.
My neighbor, Mrs. Miller, gave me a lamp and three plants.
Then I got a job at Sam's café. I worked every weekend, and I made a lot of coffee!
I went to a Blue Monday concert, I ate Omar's maqluba, and I bought my first winter coat.
Was it easy? No, it wasn't. Some days I was tired, and I missed my family.
But I learned a lot, and now Boston is my second home.

sections.title: Grammar: questions with did
look: **Did** you **go** to the sea? — No, I **didn't**.
rules: Question: **Did** + person + verb: **Did** you **buy** …? (not Did you bought …?)
Short answers: Yes, I **did**. / No, I **didn't**.
With a question word: **What / Where / When did** you …?
With **be**, no did: **Was** it easy? **Were** you tired?
examples: Did you have a good weekend?
Did Elif find a job? — Yes, she did.
What did you eat for breakfast?

support.tr: Geçmişte soru için did başa gelir ve fiil yalın kalır: Did you buy a coat? = Mont aldın mı? Kısa cevap: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. Soru kelimesiyle: Where did you go? = Nereye gittin? did'i Türkçedeki -mi eki gibi düşün: soruyu did yapar, fiil değişmez. be fiilinde did yok: Was it easy?
support.ar: للسؤال في الماضي نضع did في البداية ويبقى الفعل في صيغته الأصلية: Did you buy a coat? = هل اشتريتَ معطفًا؟ الجواب القصير: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't. ومع أداة الاستفهام: Where did you go? = إلى أين ذهبت؟ فكّر في did مثل «هل»: هي التي تصنع السؤال، والفعل لا يتغيّر. ومع be لا نستخدم did: Was it easy?

tr.note: Soruda did varsa fiil geçmiş hâle girmez. Soru kelimesinden sonra did'i unutma.

ar.note: لا تسأل بدون did، ولا تستخدم صيغة الماضي بعد did.

sections.title: Write: My last month

model.heading: My first year in Boston — Lucas
text: I came to Boston last year, in August.
At first, I didn't have any friends, and my English wasn't very good.
Then I met Jake in a music store, and we started a band, Blue Monday.
I found an apartment with two roommates, from Korea and Mexico.
We always speak English at home, so I learned a lot.
Was it easy? No, it wasn't.
But I love Boston now … and I'm never late for class! Well, sometimes.
